display.title: How the gates work
display.subtitle: Boss drops unlock tiers
description: Machine hulls for MV, HV, EV, IV, LuV and ZPM can only be made in an Assembler, and each recipe needs a Cataclysm boss drop as a catalyst.
The catalyst is NOT consumed. Kill each boss once, keep the drop, and craft as many hulls of that tier as you like.
